rationale: The agent verified identity properly after the email lookup failed by matching full name and ZIP to a single account, then operated only on that user’s pending order. It used read tools to retrieve order details, correctly identified the most expensive item, and sought explicit confirmation before any order-changing action. When the item-removal tool rejected the operation (exchange-only constraint), the agent did not fabricate capabilities and instead offered policy-compliant alternatives. Upon the user’s choice, the agent requested explicit confirmation and then successfully canceled the pending order via the proper tool. The final information (order canceled, refund to the same card) matches the tool results. Minor generic statements (refund timeline, examples of payment methods) do not contradict tool outputs and no unauthorized writes were made without confirmation.
